name: Release
why: A merged change, from its tag and notes to every adopter's pin up to date
ideal: A reviewed merge is tagged by the semver table and released with grouped notes. Dependabot moves every adopter's pin within one cooldown.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Automatically generated release notes
GitHub Docs: About Dependabot version updates

steps.name: Merge
tools: A review pinned to the head SHA
steps.rule: Tag only a change that was reviewed at its head and merged green.

steps.name: Tag
tools: A tag ruleset that blocks moves and deletes
steps.rule: Tag the merge commit by the semver table: patch, minor or major. A tag never moves.

steps.name: Notes
steps.rule: Each tag gets a GitHub Release whose notes group the merged pull requests by label.

steps.name: Bump
tools: A weekly schedule with a cooldown
steps.rule: Dependabot proposes the new pin once a week, in one grouped pull request, after the cooldown.

steps.name: Check
steps.rule: The bump's pull request runs the standard checks on included minutes, and merges when all are green.

steps.name: Current
steps.rule: Every adopter's pin sits at or above the newest tag that is one cooldown old.
